user.title: Add a receiver
user.description: To add a receiver that isn't paired with this host yet, turn the receiver on and hold BLUETOOTH on its remote for about 3 seconds so it enters pairing mode, then scan. Its "BluetoothStandby" setting should be on.

not_found.title: No receiver found
not_found.description: No receiver showed up. Check that it's on and in range, hold BLUETOOTH on its remote for about 3 seconds to restart pairing mode, then scan again. If another device (a phone, a computer) is connected to it, disconnect that first.

scan_failed.title: Scan failed
scan_failed.description: Could not scan for Bluetooth devices. Check that this host has a Bluetooth adapter and that Home Assistant can reach BlueZ.

found.title: Pick the receiver
found.description: Devices found nearby. Picking one pairs it with this host.

paired.title: Pick the receiver
paired.description: Classic Bluetooth devices already paired with this host.

manual.title: Enter the address
manual.description: The receiver must already be paired with this host.

progress.scan: Scanning for up to a minute. If you haven't yet, turn the receiver on and hold BLUETOOTH on its remote for about 3 seconds.

error.cannot_connect: Could not open the receiver's control channel ({detail}). Check that it is paired, in range and powered on (or in standby with BluetoothStandby on).
error.pairing_failed: Pairing failed ({detail}). Check the receiver still shows Pairing Mode, then try again.

store_preset.name: Store tuner preset
store_preset.description: Saves the station the tuner is playing to a preset slot.
